items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to go over to Elmo Hope’s house, Elmo and Bertha.

ctx.x: And it would be continuous. He – brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr, like that. You say, are you serious? Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr. He was something. So we’re back playing. We got back up on the stage and started playing when Marilyn Monroe was there. They got up to walk out, and the band stopped. We had to go see from the backside. The whole band stopped. We had to check it out from the backside. Whoo. Boy, it was happening, boy, yeah. Then Lenny Bruce came. Lenny Bruce, he had to say a whole bunch of stuff about Marilyn Monroe…
